title: Not an MCP server — no MCP protocol, SDK, transport, or tool registration
evidence: grep for mcp|jsonrpc|stdio|AddTool|RegisterTool across *.go returns nothing; go.mod (module soccer-mcp, go 1.26.4) has zero dependencies. server/server.go:39 exposes a plain Query(string) library method; main.go:18 calls srv.Run() which (server/server.go:653-664) only prints a banner and runs ONE hardcoded example query s.Query("Who won the 2019 Brasileirao?"). No tool definitions, no JSON-RPC/stdio loop.
suggestion: Add an MCP server SDK, register the query functions as MCP tools, and serve over stdio/JSON-RPC.

title: Match-by-team lookup returns empty for all real data (case-mismatch bug)
evidence: query/match_query.go:319 normalizeTeamName lowercases the query team ("Flamengo"->"flamengo"), but the loader stores names case-preserved: loader/loader.go:725 normalizeTeamName only strips state suffix + trims (no ToLower), and its alias lookup at loader/loader.go:743 queries a FRESH models.NewDataStore() whose TeamAliases is empty (models/models.go:157), so it always misses and returns the raw-cased name (e.g. "Palmeiras"). match_query.go:66 (FindMatchesByTeam) and :36 (FindMatchesByTeams) compare match.HomeTeam==team with ==, so "Palmeiras"=="palmeiras" is never true. Data IS present (data/kaggle/*.csv all exist), so these return [] for every real team query.
suggestion: Lowercase both sides of the comparison, or make loader and query use one shared normalizeTeamName that lowercases consistently.

title: Team W/L/D + goals stats always empty (same case-mismatch bug)
evidence: query/match_query.go:154 GetTeamStats normalizes the query team to lowercase (:155) then compares match.HomeTeam==team / match.AwayTeam==team (:170-186). Stored names are case-preserved (loader/loader.go:725), so no match is ever counted and every TeamStats returns all-zero (Wins/Draws/Losses/GoalsFor all 0).
suggestion: Fix the shared team-name normalization so stored and queried names match case.

title: Head-to-head record always returns zeros (same case-mismatch bug)
evidence: server/server.go:131 answerTeamMatchQuery calls GetHeadToHead("Flamengo","Fluminense"); query/match_query.go:212 GetHeadToHead delegates to FindMatchesByTeams (:218) which lowercases the query teams and fails to match the case-preserved stored names, so h2h.Matches is empty and Team1Wins/Team2Wins/Draws stay 0.
suggestion: Same fix as R3 — normalize team-name case consistently between loader and query.

title: TestSoccerServer_Run is skipped when data is absent
evidence: server/server_test.go:301 t.Skipf("Skipping test - no data: %v", err) — the only end-to-end test that loads real data and would have exposed the team-name case-mismatch bug is skipped; the remaining 22 tests only exercise pure format/helper functions.
suggestion: Add a small fixture CSV so the query paths are tested against real data, which would have caught R3/R6/R11.

title: Test coverage very low (0.104)
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.104; tests build and run (defect_rate=1.0) but exercise mostly formatting helpers, not the query/loader logic where the defects live.
suggestion: Cover FindMatchesByTeam, GetTeamStats and GetHeadToHead against loaded data.
